item.text: The reference appears to show a wide base, a back plate leaning away from it, and a small central retaining tab near the bend. I’m matching the main plates first, then I’ll add the tab and openings.

The main plates now form one valid solid, with the base extending toward negative Y and the back rising toward positive Y and Z. I’m refining the back angle against the diagonal views before adding the central details.

The corner positions suggest a base length about 80% of the width, with the back rising about 90% of the width and leaning back about 40%. I’ll use those proportions and add the central openings and local tab.
